gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-kr: Friendly and retro, Junegull pinches its curves nearly shut, while Noto Sans KR keeps its own gaps generous and wide. That closed-versus-open split is the whole charm of this pairing.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-lao: Junegull draws every stroke like twine pressed flat, with pinched curves that nearly close up. But Noto Sans Lao lifts its x-height high and leaves every mouth open, so paragraphs move along freely.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Retro and friendly, Junegull squeezes its curves almost shut. Noto Sans Lepcha keeps its curves broad and unhurried, so text rolls along easily, paragraph after paragraph, without any strain.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase and opens its curves like a sprung paper clip. Text beneath Junegull reads smoothly and gently, one line following another.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-malayal: Chunky, pinched and cheerful: Junegull makes every diagonal as stout as every upright. And Noto Sans Malayalam fills the line with a dominant middle zone and generous s bends, so reading flows.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Flat and friendly: Junegull draws one plain, unshaded line that never swells, with every curve pinched nearly shut at the mouth. Noto Sans Marchen counters with proud small letters and curves ending in clear daylight.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-mayan-n: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals stands tall, its c gaping at any size. Junegull, closed and pinched at every curve, hands over to text that moves along openly and easily.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-medefai: Junegull holds a single constant line width, with curves pinched nearly shut. Noto Sans Medefaidrin rises high and leaves its curves unclogged, so the two feel like friendly opposites.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-meetei-: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek reads open, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. Junegull, drawn like a technical pen line and pinched shut at the curves, gives the pairing its sharpest contrast.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-meroiti: Junegull traces every line as if with one marker tip, then pinches each curve almost closed. Noto Sans Meroitic, see-through at the c, reads freely and comfortably beneath it.
